Build a GWU enchantment-and-bestow deck around Kestia, using cheap ramp and enchantment-based card draw to cast bestow creatures and auras that trigger Kestia's attack draw. Removal and Winds of Rath/Austere Command handle threats, with the rest of the budget left unspent since the list totals about $45.

Bant enchantment-go-wide deck: cheap ramp and enchantment-draw engines fuel a heavy bestow and aura suite that turns each creature into a card-drawing threat through Kestia's attack trigger. Removal and Winds of Rath stay in the deck to handle opposing blockers while the auras, which spare enchanted creatures from Winds of Rath, carry the damage.

meta.strategy: Sultai value deck that ramps early with mana rocks, elves, and fetching creatures, then recurs permanents from the graveyard with Muldrotha each turn. Reanimation spells, Eternal Witness, and cheap removal keep the graveyard stocked and the board under control.

Sultai value-graveyard deck: ramp with Sol Ring and signets into cheap permanents, then refill the yard with Mulldrifter, Strix, Sidisi, and mill creatures so Muldrotha can recast a permanent of each type every turn. Removal and Liliana, Death's Majesty handle threats while Eternal Witness and Liliana the Repentant recur key pieces.

meta.strategy: Fill the graveyard with self-mill, cheap creatures, and ramp, then recast permanents from it each turn using Muldrotha's free permanent-type casting. Removal and sweepers keep the board clear while recursion and reanimation keep card advantage flowing.

Atraxa's end-step proliferate pairs with counter-based synergies, infect and toxic creatures, and planeswalkers, so the deck ramps into its engines and draws steadily. It runs about 34 lands with a removal suite and a few sweepers to protect the board while the counters build.

Go wide with cheap Goblin token makers, Goblin lords, and Krenko's tap ability, so Krenko, Mob Boss scales with every Goblin on the battlefield. Ramp with Sol Ring and mana rocks to power out the commander early, use Skullclamp and cheap draw for card advantage, and clear the way with burn and sweepers.

Build a red Goblin token deck around Krenko's Commander-tap engine, with cheap token makers and mana rocks to accelerate the goblin count. Add Skullclamp and cheap looters for card flow, plus burn and sacrifice outlets to finish games while staying well under budget.

Krenko's tap ability scales with Goblins, so the deck floods the board with cheap Goblin token makers, Goblin lords, and ramp to fuel repeated activations. Skullclamp, Fable, and Chieftain-style lords turn the wide board into card advantage and lethal damage, while burn and sacrifice outlets clear blockers.

Build a blue instant-and-sorcery deck: cheap cantrips, counters, and removal trigger Talrand's Drake tokens on every spell. Ten mana rocks and 37 lands support a high spell count, with flyers and token makers to pressure opponents.

Run a heavy instant and sorcery count with cheap cantrips, cost reducers, and counterspells so Talrand's trigger fires every turn. Ramp into Hullbreaker Horror and Baral-style cost reduction, with bounce and counters to protect the board and keep drake tokens attacking.

Blue instant-and-sorcery spellslinger built around Talrand's drake triggers, with cheap cantrips, counterspells, and flying cost reducers to keep the noncreature spell count high. Ramp from mana rocks, Sol Ring, and Solemn Simulacrum accelerates into Consecrated Sphinx, Lyra, and Shark Typhoon while bounce and counters protect the board.

Proliferate-focused counters and poison deck: ramp into Tekuthal and cheap proliferate creatures, then grind with cheap removal and card flow. Two cheap wipes and counter-based protection let Atraxa's counter engine survive while the opponent's board is cleared.

Build an Elf tribal deck that ramps out early Elves and removal, then swarms with menace and token-making. Elf synergies like Imperious Perfect, Elvish Archdruid and Elvish Warmaster grow the board so Lathril's combat damage and the ten-Elf drain become reachable.

Build a B/G Elf tribal deck that ramps out early Elves, then floods the board with Elves and Elf tokens to power Lathril's menace attacks and token generation. Cheap ramp, card draw, and cheap removal keep the deck functional while Lathril's ten-Elf drain ability becomes a late-game finisher.

Mono-green Elf tribal: ramp with mana elves and Sol Ring, then flood the board with Elf Warrior tokens from Imperious Perfect, Elvish Warmaster, Elvish Promenade and Elven Ambush. Pump the team with Elf lords, Skullclamp and Lathril's menace, and use the removal and ten-Elf drain as a finisher.

Mono-black Vampires built around Edgar's attack trigger, with cheap Vampire lords, sacrifice and drain payoffs, and token makers to grow the team each turn. Ramp via Sol Ring and signets, card draw from Skullclamp and Welcoming Vampire, and cheap removal plus Olivia's Wrath, which is a one-sided wipe here because it scales off your Vampire count.

Run a dense W/B Vampire deck built around Edgar's attack trigger, with cheap Vampires and token makers feeding +1/+1 counters. Ramp with mana rocks and Command Tower, draw through Skullclamp and card advantage, and clear blockers with cheap removal and Olivia's Wrath.

Grist's +1 makes Insect tokens and mills toward more Insects, so this deck fills the board with cheap Insects, sacrifice fodder, and graveyard creatures. Mana rocks and mill-based card draw keep Grist's ability and the graveyard synergies running, while removal and Vraska handle opposing threats.

Build a Golgari go-wide insect deck: ramp with Sol Ring and signets into Hornet Queen, Ant Queen, and Scute Mob, then fill the graveyard with creatures to power Grist's −5 and Izoni, Aatchik, and Lolth-style sacrifice engines. Removal and sacrifice outlets clear blockers, Skullclamp and recursion keep card flow strong, and about 37 lands with Swarmyard support the mana and Insect plan.

Ramp into a go-wide Insect plan: Grist and token makers (Hornet Queen, Ant Queen, Hornet Nest) fill the board, while sacrifice and graveyard creature synergies feed Grist's -2 and Swarmyard Massacre. Cheap removal, card draw, and a few sweepers keep the board under control on the way to Grist's ultimate.

Ramp into big legendary threats and planeswalkers, using Esika's mana ability and the upkeep creature/planeswalker reveal to stack the board. Cheap ramp, card draw and efficient removal keep the deck flowing while the legendary creatures carry the game.

Ramp into Esika's mana-doubling and planeswalker-friendly plan, using cheap ramp, card filtering, and cheap removal to keep the deck within budget. Legendary creatures and planeswalkers are emphasized so Esika's vigilance and mana-granting ability and the upkeep creature-drop engine get more value.

Ramp hard with mana rocks, Farseek-style fixers, and a 36-land base, then convert the surplus mana into planeswalkers and card advantage. Legendary creatures and planeswalkers get stacked to exploit Esika's mana and vigilance, with removal and wipes covering the early game.

Build an artifact-heavy Karn deck where Karn's upkeep colorless mana and the artifact count power its ramp, card draw, and big colorless threats. Ramp and cheap artifacts make Karn large and let Ugin, Karn Living Legacy, and Karn Liberated-style removal and wipes control the board.

Build an artifact-heavy colorless ramp deck: stack cheap mana rocks and artifact threats so Karn's mana from artifacts and Karn's power scale quickly. Use card draw, colorless removal, and a few wipes that spare artifacts to protect the board while the commander grows.

Build an artifact-dense colorless deck where Sol Ring, Thran Dynamo, and cheap Myr and Hedron mana feed Karn's upkeep mana and artifact spells. Pair colorless ramp and draw with cheap artifact creatures, Karn the Great Creator, and flexible colorless removal to grow Karn's power while protecting the board.

Vampire aristocrats built around Edgar's first strike and attack trigger, with Olivia Voldaren as the bomb, cheap removal, and sacrifice fodder to feed the Vampire synergies. Budget forced cheap filler to reach 62+ picks, so the list leans on low-cost Vampires, card draw, and efficient removal, with 38 total lands and mana rocks to accelerate.
